content.short: Ondo Finance tokenizes institutional-grade financial products on-chain, offering OUSG (US Treasuries) and USDY (yield-bearing stablecoin) for everyone.
content.description: Ondo Finance is a leading real-world asset (RWA) protocol that tokenizes institutional financial products and makes them accessible on-chain, with flagship products including OUSG (tokenized US Treasuries) and USDY (a yield-bearing stablecoin backed by US Treasuries). The protocol bridges the gap between traditional finance and DeFi by giving on-chain users access to the yields and safety of regulated financial instruments. Ondo's deployment on Mantle extends access to these high-quality instruments to Mantle DeFi users seeking stable, yield-generating dollar exposure.
content.meta: Ondo Finance brings tokenized US Treasuries and institutional-grade financial products on-chain for Mantle users.
